svg.title: The Scaling Collection — Scales and dragon-eye heading artwork
svg.desc: A close-up of the custom steel-and-black heading: clipped scale details inside the Scaling S and slit-pupil dragon eyes inside the two Collection o letters. The underlying Alegreya Sans font and selected logo files remain unchanged.
svg.metadata: Landing page hero design concept. Illustrative archive copy and dragon type cards. Selected v8 Swordslapper Classic underline logo foreground reused unchanged. Restrained editorial typography; Alegreya Sans is licensed in logos/v7/fonts, and optional Grenze Regular in logos/v6/fonts. DragonSlapper by Allison James (NAL), copyright 2013, via https://www.fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/830154/dragonslapper; CC BY-SA 3.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Original font file unchanged; the outlined glyphs included here remain under CC BY-SA 3.0. Not an implemented application.
